decision: The ticket was closed on 17/12/2024 (event-036) although the only work-result evidence — two contractor emails of 13/12 (event-016, event-017) — reports the window repair completed at "Flat 7, 177 Beacon Close, Kingshaven, ZZ7 3ZZ", a different property from this ticket's Flat 20, 120 Lantern Quay (index, event-011). I recorded the conflict (ACT-1), asked Riverside Solutions to confirm the address, date, parts and to send quote/invoice and photos with a 2-working-day reply-by (ACT-2), asked the tenant whether anyone attended and whether the window now opens (ACT-3), and raised an office task on the mis-addressed result and the thin final checks (ACT-4).
